correctness.rationale: Since A commutes with dI, binomial rearrangement yields T_s(h)=Σ_{j=0}^s h^j A^j E_{s-j}(-dh)/j!. Alternating Taylor sums E_m(-x)≥0 for 0≤x≤1, all A^j≥0, and T_s 1=1, proving sufficient stochasticity. For witness (u,v), A^j_uv=0 j<s-1, A^{s-1}_uv>0, A^s_uv=0, so exact entry h^{s-1}A^{s-1}_uv(1-dh)/(s-1)! <0 at every h>1/d. A bipartite geodesic of length s-1 gives shorter walk absence and opposite-parity s-walk absence. Applies to directed bipartite strongly connected constant-exit-rate chains too. Independently checked 5 C8 RK4 rational step transition signs and stochastic rows, including explicit h³(1-2h)/6 witness.
residual_risks: Walk gap is sufficient, not necessary; no classical nonlinear RK order s claim for s>4.
